_leeme: Páginas de caso. Cada caso genera <slug>.html con: python3 scripts/build-cases.py. Los textos van como {"es": …, "en": …} o como texto solo si es igual en los dos idiomas. Los bloques se muestran en el orden de la lista; tipos: hero, cover, facts, story, split-video, sheet, gallery, before-after, steps, prompt, video-embed, ext-link, next. El orden de los casos (contador y 'siguiente') es el de data/works.json. Explicación de cada bloque en scripts/build-cases.py.

blocks.label: anzu_raw.prompt
blocks.text:
Ultra-realistic cinematic sports editorial photo of [PLAYER: adult male] portrayed as a field herpetologist / conservation biologist, premium campaign realism, serious attitude.
Match the provided face reference for identity (high similarity). The provided club jersey must be visible under wardrobe (open lab coat/tunic, tasteful).
Wardrobe (mandatory): white lab coat/tunic (slightly open), black nitrile gloves, clear laboratory safety glasses...
Output: 3:4 vertical, 4K, extremely detailed, magazine cover realism.
No text, no logos, no badges, no watermarks, no UI.
